question: For each pizza order, provide a single result row with the row ID, order ID, customer ID, pizza name, and final set of ingredients. The final ingredients are determined by starting with the standard toppings from the pizza’s recipe, removing any excluded toppings, and adding any extra toppings. Present the ingredients in a string starting with the pizza name followed by ': ', with ingredients listed in alphabetical order. Ingredients appearing multiple times (e.g., from standard and extra toppings) should be prefixed with '2x' and listed first, followed by single-occurrence ingredients, both in alphabetical order. Group by row ID, order ID, pizza name, and order time to ensure each order appears once. Sort results by row ID in ascending order. Assign pizza_id 1 to 'Meatlovers' pizzas and pizza_id 2 to all others.

-- Fix: '2x' should be prefix (before the ingredient name)
WITH order_items AS (
    SELECT 
        rowid as row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        exclusions,
        extras,
        order_time
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
recipe_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        r.pizza_id,
        trim(t.topping_id::VARCHAR) as topping_id,
        pt.topping_name
    FROM pizza_recipes r,
         unnest(split(trim(r.toppings), ',')) as t(topping_id)
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON trim(t.topping_id::VARCHAR) = CAST(pt.topping_id AS VARCHAR)
),
excluded_topping_ids AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.row_id,
        trim(ex.topping_id::VARCHAR) as topping_id
    FROM order_items oi,
         unnest(split(trim(oi.exclusions), ',')) as ex(topping_id)
    WHERE oi.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND oi.exclusions != ''
),
extra_topping_ids AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.row_id,
        trim(ex.topping_id::VARCHAR) as topping_id
    FROM order_items oi,
         unnest(split(trim(oi.extras), ',')) as ex(topping_id)
    WHERE oi.extras IS NOT NULL AND oi.extras != ''
),
extra_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        eti.row_id,
        eti.topping_id,
        pt.topping_name
    FROM extra_topping_ids eti
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON eti.topping_id = CAST(pt.topping_id AS VARCHAR)
),
all_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.row_id,
        oi.order_id,
        oi.customer_id,
        oi.pizza_id,
        oi.order_time,
        rt.topping_name
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN recipe_toppings rt ON oi.pizza_id = rt.pizza_id
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM excluded_topping_ids et WHERE et.row_id = oi.row_id AND et.topping_id = rt.topping_id
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        oi.row_id,
        oi.order_id,
        oi.customer_id,
        oi.pizza_id,
        oi.order_time,
        et.topping_name
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN extra_toppings et ON oi.row_id = et.row_id
),
topping_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time,
        topping_name,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM all_toppings
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, topping_name
),
multi_ingredients AS (
    SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time,
           string_agg('2x' || topping_name, ', ' ORDER BY topping_name) as multi_ingredients
    FROM (
        SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, topping_name, cnt
        FROM topping_counts
        WHERE cnt > 1
    )
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time
),
single_ingredients AS (
    SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time,
           string_agg(topping_name, ', ' ORDER BY topping_name) as single_ingredients
    FROM (
        SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, topping_name, cnt
        FROM topping_counts
        WHERE cnt = 1
    )
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time
)
SELECT 
    tc.row_id,
    tc.order_id,
    tc.customer_id,
    tn.pizza_name,
    tc.order_time,
    COALESCE(multi.multi_ingredients, '') as multi_ing,
    COALESCE(single.single_ingredients, '') as single_ing
FROM topping_counts tc
JOIN pizza_names tn ON tc.pizza_id = tn.pizza_id
LEFT JOIN multi_ingredients multi ON tc.row_id = multi.row_id
LEFT JOIN single_ingredients single ON tc.row_id = single.row_id
GROUP BY tc.row_id, tc.order_id, tc.customer_id, tn.pizza_name, tc.order_time, multi.multi_ingredients, single.single_ingredients
ORDER BY tc.row_id
